title: Burst sampler heuristics and quant-profile assembler for conservative cost smoothing
author: Samira Patel
description: Motivation: reduce unit-token cost volatility during short high-QPS bursts by introducing a burst-aware sampler that biases prefill and microbatch decisions toward conservative sizes during spikes; provide a companion quant-profile assembler that generates stable fallback quantization profiles per workload segment so teams can trade cost for quality safely. This PR implements the sampler algorithm in the runtime prefill controller, a lightweight assembler that emits YAML quant profiles and stability signatures, a CLI integration (econctl) to preview suggested profiles, new telemetry hooks, docs, and integration tests. Checklist: - [x] implement burst sampler logic with decay window and emergency throttle - [x] add quant-profile assembler and serializer - [x] expose econ.unit_cost_estimate & econ.batch_utilization_ratio metrics - [x] add econctl preview + simulation flags - [x] update docs and presets - [x] add unit + e2e smoke tests - [ ] run extended canary before global rollout. Related work: ENG-1482 (design), PL-332 (product requirements). Design doc: https://internal.link/designs/burst-sampler-quant-assembler. Rollout: feature gate off by default; operator opt-in via configs/presets/burst-sampler.yaml. Safety: assembler only proposes backward-compatible quant steps and attaches a stability signature that the rollout controller uses to gate automatic promotion; sampler fallbacks guarantee max-latency SLOs by immediately relaxing batch size on tail-latency alerts. Migration notes: no data migration; operators must add the new preset file and enable the feature flag to activate. Testing: local simulation harness included, integration test with dedicated canary added. Merge method: squash and merge to keep history compact. For follow-ups: expand simulator scenarios, add golden prompt regression tests before wide rollout.

release_notes: Introduce burst-aware prefill sampler and quant-profile assembler. Operators can opt into conservative burst handling presets to reduce unit-cost volatility during spikes; includes new econctl preview tooling and telemetry. Default behavior unchanged until feature flag enabled.
summary: Adds a runtime burst sampler to stabilize batching decisions during traffic spikes and a quant-profile assembler that emits safe fallback quantization configs. Includes CLI preview, telemetry, docs, and tests. Opt-in rollout behind feature gate.
